findings.text: non-blocking: the node declared an evidence fragment and its figure directory but delivered neither, so the 122-to-2 listing measurement exists only in the run manifest and the commit body and no plan-facing record carries it.

non-blocking: the base arm substitutes a hand-written stand-in for the base revision's read pattern, so if the derivation's readers stopped consulting _live_pointers the stand-in would still list per duty and line 258's listing count would still pass while no longer reproducing what the base revision did.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base eed783c702b1; 6b2143b867 adds the publication and the 272-line test, 16331f4e31 widens the base-read stand-in in tests/test_fleet_state_reads_the_live_pointers_once.py so it drops the population it is now offered, and no file outside the declared scope is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_an_obligation_sweep_lists_live_pointers_once.py with 200 pointers, 60 delivered review duties over three sessions, <=3 listings, <=600 copied records and base-pattern equality; that file asserts MAX_LISTINGS (3) at line 237, MAX_RECORDS (600) at line 240, the population seen at line 228, and the two-arm equality at line 263.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is "Make one obligation-snapshot sweep list the live directory a bounded number of times whatever the number of review duties"; reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:2070 now publishes state.pointers as the slice's live snapshot around the per-duty derivation, so the sweep's listing count is set by the derivation and not by the 60 review duties.
item_verdicts.manifest: read /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261119T145852346953-an-obligation-sweep-lists-live-pointers-once/manifest.md, which records the gate at 60 passed EXIT=0, base arm 58 passed EXIT=0, after arm 60 passed EXIT=0, and the negative control red at base with 122 listings; two declared paths, the evidence fragment and the figure, are absent from its changed_paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the reviewed dispatch's declared paths (obligations.py, obligation_snapshot.py, the new test, an evidence fragment, a figure directory, and tests/test_fleet_state_reads_the_live_pointers_once.py); the diff touches three of the six and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_obligation_sweep_lists_live_pointers_once.py:237 reddens on the regression reinstated in the recorded negative control (122 listings at base, EXIT=1), and line 258 makes the equality arm prove it took the base read pattern rather than comparing one path with itself.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_an_obligation_sweep_lists_live_pointers_once.py:237 and :240 assert the done_when's two bounds, the manifest records 60 passed EXIT=0, and I re-ran that test at head 16331f4e31 for 2 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: the split of payload_for into _payload_for_state at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:2076 follows the module's private-helper and docstring idiom, and ruff check plus ruff format --check pass on all three changed files.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:2072 publishes the held population for the length of each slice, so runs.py:_publish_obligation_snapshots no longer pays a listing per review duty.
justifications.reuse: the publication is obligations.live_pointer_snapshot (reckon/crew/obligations.py:824), the owner of the published population that _live_pointers reads, and the search of reckon/crew found open_run_index.py:23 owning only the nested read scope this owner already consumes, so the change extends the owner rather than forking it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path (obligation_snapshot.py, the new test, test_fleet_state_reads_the_live_pointers_once.py) is inside those declared, but the declared evidence fragment and figure under docs/ are not written at all.
